entries.label: No zero Covid
entries.summary: China's zero-Covid policy fails but Xi cannot change course.
entries.quote: The initial success of China's zero-Covid policy and Xi's personal attachment to it makes it impossible to change course.

entries.label: Technopolar world
entries.summary: Digital space is even less governed than the physical world.
entries.quote: The physical world is a mess because no countries are willing or able to provide global leadership; digital space is even more poorly governed.

entries.label: US midterms
entries.summary: The US midterm vote is a tipping point without causing an immediate crisis.
entries.quote: This year's vote will not itself provoke a crisis, but it represents a historic tipping point.

entries.label: China at home
entries.summary: Xi's policies raise the risk of stagnation in a weak Chinese economy.
entries.quote: Xi's policies increase the risk of stagnation at a time when the Chinese economy is on weak footing.

entries.label: Russia
entries.summary: Putin acts if the West gives no concessions.
entries.quote: If Putin doesn't get concessions from the US-led West, he is likely to act.

entries.label: Iran
entries.summary: Iran does not want to revive the nuclear deal, and the US is unprepared for that.
entries.quote: The Biden administration failed to prepare for the possibility that Iran would not be interested in reviving the nuclear deal.

entries.label: Two steps greener, one step back
entries.summary: The energy transition continues but with setbacks.
entries.quote: The energy transition is happening, but it won't be smooth.

entries.label: Empty lands
entries.summary: No power fills the global vacuum and many regions suffer.
entries.quote: No one will fill the global power vacuum; many countries and regions will suffer the consequences.

entries.label: Corporates losing the culture wars
entries.summary: Multinationals in both the West and China face pressure from two sides.
entries.quote: Multinationals with operations in the West and China will face a “two-way risk.”

entries.label: Turkey
entries.summary: Erdogan uses combative foreign policy to distract from economic crisis.
entries.quote: Erdogan's foreign policy positions will remain combative to distract voters from the economic crisis.

entries.label: Cold War 2.0
entries.summary: Eurasia Group rejects the view that the US and China are in a new Cold War.
entries.quote: We keep hearing this argument: The US and China are locked in a new Cold War. It's wrong.
